capability.title: Generic Evidence Closure
capability.outcome: Generic origin/detail/stop-control evidence is recomputed from current repo and DB truth and yields a defensible go/no-go decision.
acceptance_criteria: All remaining generic gaps have explicit evidence owners.
validation: Full report chain passes or blocks with named missing dependency.

stories.title: Fresh GENERIC/EXPAND Evidence Recompute
stories.outcome: Current repo/DB evidence replaces dated exports and identifies the exact blocker.
acceptance_criteria: Missing dependency returns blocked, not guessed continuation.
No June snapshot is treated as current.
validation: Full report chain, CI, targeted tests.

stories.title: PROVIDER-001C Coverage Decision Bundle
stories.outcome: Provider-backed origin coverage is accepted, rejected or narrowed with DB-backed evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Decision names covered providers and remaining gaps.
Generic proof receives a decision, not raw report volume.
validation: Provider report tests and DB read-only audit.

stories.title: GENERIC Final Recheck
stories.outcome: The proof matrix returns passed or a finite named gap set from current evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Positive, negative/no-actionable and provider-backed cases are evidenced.
No placeholder evidence closes a gap.
validation: GENERIC targeted tests and full report-chain run.

stories.title: Stop-Control Repair Strategy Coverage
stories.outcome: All active stop categories route to a bounded repair, review or accepted terminal outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Repair strategy registry covers active stop taxonomy.
Unknown stop types fail closed with operator review.
validation: Stop taxonomy and representative repair tests.
